topic: Hybrid Candidate Union Architecture, Score Normalization Prohibition, and Task 3A Acceptance
problem_statement: Define formal integration contract between Task 3A Collaborative Filtering (Spark ALS) and Task 3B Knowledge Graph recommender to prevent design antipatterns like forced ALS-only reranking or raw score addition.
root_cause: Sequential filtering (feeding only ALS Top-20 into KG) suffocates catalog exploration and eliminates KG cold-start and long-tail items, since ALS item coverage is under 0.5%. Furthermore, ALS raw scores are unbounded inner products (up to ~11.0), which mathematically dominate [0, 1] graph scores if summed directly without normalization.
solution_or_decision: Established formal integration contract in docs/3a/integration_contract.md: (1) Mandated Candidate Union architecture (Candidates_Hybrid = Candidates_ALS union Candidates_KG); (2) Prohibited direct unnormalized raw score addition, requiring per-user Min-Max normalization or Reciprocal Rank Fusion; (3) Standardized shared MovieLens 64-bit int userId and movieId; (4) Completed full regression test suite (180 tests PASS) and verified 25/25 quality gates in m10_release_checklist.json with formal verdict TASK_3A_ENGINEERING_RELEASE_PASS.
evidence: Candidate union verified in test_18 with 5 ALS candidates and 3 KG candidates producing exactly 7 unique candidates, preserving 100% of KG-only items (999101, 999102). Test_20 confirmed unnormalized score addition resulted in 89.4% ALS domination, whereas Min-Max normalization restored balanced 50/50 weighting. Full Task 3A regression test suite passed: 180/180 tests across 12 files. 25/25 release gates PASS.
